templates.edit:
Use the built-in image_gen tool (imagegen skill, built-in mode only; do not use the CLI fallback or any API key).
Edit target: the attached image, a CCTV still of a data-centre cold-aisle containment entrance.
Change: {change}
The containment doors are sliding doors: each door panel stays flat and parallel to the doorway and only moves sideways along the top track. Never rotate, swing or hinge a door panel, and never show a door angled outwards or inwards.
Keep unchanged: camera position, angle, framing and wide-angle lens distortion; lighting and exposure; server racks and their LEDs; floor tiles; ceiling; the door sign; the door frame and track; wall labels; the image's slightly soft, compressed surveillance-camera quality.
People: {people}
Avoid: new objects other than those named in the change; motion blur; changes to any text; making the image sharper, more colourful or more cinematic than the original.
Output: one 1280x720 image. Copy the final image to {out_path} and print that path.
